summary: Iteration 4: backend regression suite passed 5/5. Public mobile preview loads, but the fixed create wizard Continuar action is still outside the 390x844 viewport, blocking create-flow verification.

ui_bugs.issue: On the public 390x844 preview, create-order-continue-button bounding box is y=1617.36, outside the viewport; the wizard cannot advance.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete UI publish and reopen-at-step-1 verification because Continuar is untappable.

issues: Modal action footer is laid out far below the mobile viewport despite the ScrollView/flex footer change.

action_items: Fix CreateModalFixed web/mobile layout so the footer and create-order-continue-button have a viewport-bound box at 390x844; retest all four steps and reopen reset.
Align frontend API configuration with the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract or explicitly preserve/document EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
Implement and expose completion/rating UI if those MVP flows remain in scope.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the stated environment contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current preview works only because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is configured.
Completion and rating controls are absent from the frontend although backend endpoints exist and the stated MVP includes concluir/avaliar.
Several interactive controls (explore search/chips, message row, profile settings, proposal/detail actions) lack stable testIDs required by the design/test contract.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (load/navigation visible; create blocked; downstream UI not verified)

seed_data_creation: Regression suite created TEST_regression_order, TEST proposal, and TEST message; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL is https://faze-fazedores.preview.emergentagent.com. Proposal fix was previously verified in iteration 3; prioritize measuring create-order-continue-button after layout changes.
rca_of_issue: The fixed wizard still produces a native-web layout box below the viewport when opened through the public Expo preview. Although the footer is outside the ScrollView in source, Modal/SafeAreaView sizing or parent flex sizing causes the modal content to resolve at document y≈1617. The first tap cannot execute setStep.
